inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Azure NSG Rule Modified to Allow Any Source IP

properties.description: This rule would help to identify if any user tried to modify Azure NSG tule to allow Any Source IP
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Azure NSG Rule Modified to Allow Any Source IP
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue endswith 'NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/WRITE' //can change this, linkedin turns the full operation name into a shortened link
| where ActivitySubstatusValue == 'OK'
| extend nsgName = split(_ResourceId, "/", 8)[0]
| extend data = parse_json(
                    dynamic_to_json(
                        parse_json(
                            dynamic_to_json(
                                parse_json
    (
                                    dynamic_to_json(parse_json(Properties_d).responseBody)
                                ).properties
                            )
                        ).securityRules.[0]
                    )
                ).properties
| extend
    description = data.description,
    sourceAddress = data.sourceAddressPrefix,
    port = data.destinationPortRange, 
    direction = data.direction,
    destinationAddress = data.destinationAddressPrefix
| where sourceAddress == '*' //looking for any source IP
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    sourceAddress,
    port,
    direction,
    destinationAddress,
    nsgName,
    description,
    Caller,
    CallerIpAddress
